brief: Sales calls before and after AI agents. Show rates, close rates, hours per close. What automation actually does to a solo founder's funnel.

slots.title: Stop doing
slots.description: See how AI agents transform a solo founder's call funnel from grind to growth.

slots.title: Stop begging for
slots.description: AI agents respond instantly, 24/7, so no lead goes cold waiting for a founder.
slots.badText: Solo founder sends emails and waits days for any response.
slots.goodText: AI SDR follows up instantly across channels until they answer.

slots.title: Qualify every
slots.description: Stop wasting calls on prospects who can't buy. Let AI filter first.
slots.badText: Founder jumps on discovery calls with unqualified tire-kickers daily.
slots.goodText: AI agent asks BANT questions and books only ready buyers.

slots.title: End no-shows
slots.description: AI sends reminders and reschedules so prospects actually show up prepared.
slots.badText: Founder preps for calls that get cancelled without any warning.
slots.goodText: Bot confirms, reminds, and fills empty slots automatically each day.

slots.title: Close deals
slots.description: AI handles objections and nurtures leads until they're ready to sign.
slots.badText: Founder follows up manually and loses deals to slow response.
slots.goodText: Agent nurtures, answers objections, and books the closing call fast.

slots.title: Reclaim your
slots.description: Automation cuts the manual grind so you focus on product and vision.
slots.badText: Every sale costs dozens of hours the founder doesn't have spare.
slots.goodText: AI runs the funnel top-to-bottom with minimal oversight needed.

slots.title: Slash acquisition
slots.description: Replace expensive agencies and SDRs with one intelligent system that scales.
slots.badText: Hiring SDRs and agencies burns cash before any revenue hits.
slots.goodText: One AI agent scales infinitely without adding any headcount cost.

slots.body: Join founders who replaced manual outreach with AI agents that book and close around the clock.
